'''''Applied Econometrics and International Development''''' is a biannual [[peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] covering [[econometrics]] published by the [[Euro-American Association of Economic Development Studies]]. The journal was established in 2001. The [https://aeidpublications.com/editorial-board-members/ editor-in-chief] is '''Adrian Cole Bennett''' (Los Angeles, USA).

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in [[DIALNET]],<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title=Applied Econometrics and International Development |issn=1578-4487 |access-date=2023-04-26}}</ref> [[EconLit]],<ref name=EconLit>{{cite web |title=Journals Indexed |url=https://www.aeaweb.org/econlit/journal_list.php |website=EconLit |publisher=American Economic Association |access-date=2023-04-26}}</ref> [[International Bibliography of the Social Sciences]],<ref name=MIAR/> [[Latindex]],<ref name=MIAR/> and [[Scopus]].<ref name=Scopus>{{cite web |url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/18300156729 |title=Source details: Applied Econometrics and International Development |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |work=Scopus Preview |access-date=2023-04-26}}</ref>
